prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone modular wing-pair ornament for a metallic achievement badge, transparent PNG.
Reference image: the supplied silver wing pair is MATERIAL AND RENDERING STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a distinctly new upright silhouette.
Primary request: a precisely bilateral symmetric pair of ASCENDANT WINGS, tall eagle-like wings rising steeply upward, with five large long faceted metal primary feathers on each side spreading into an upright open fan. The highest spear-shaped feathers point nearly straight UP at the upper outer corners, the shorter feathers step downward along the OUTSIDE edges. The wing roots curl inward near the bottom quarter, pointing toward where a central badge will later sit. Clearly vertical/upward energy; height of the pair about 75 percent of its total width.
Composition: front elevation, centered on a square transparent canvas, complete tips with generous 6 percent outer margin, two separate wings with a broad transparent central gap occupying 40 percent of total width, bilateral symmetry, no connecting element across the center. Both wing roots near bottom; the full upper two-thirds of each wing should remain outside the central gap and form conspicuously tall raised silhouettes. A badge will be overlaid later so DO NOT draw any badge.
Style: polished silver chrome, thick dimensional bevels, broad geometric facets, crisp dark metallic inset edges and bright white reflective highlights, clean collectible video-game insignia ornament matching the reference metal finish. Neutral grayscale only, suitable for deterministic bronze and gold recoloring.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the metal, including the center and between feathers. No background, no environmental glow, no haze, no shadow outside the metal.
Constraints: output only this single isolated pair of wings. No hexagon, no shield, no badge, no crown, no laurels, no banner, no rank marker, no text, no symbols, no watermark. Do not repeat the reference's low horizontal three-bar silhouette. Wings must be visibly tall and upright even at small icon sizes.
